;Disasters and accidents
*[[2017 Brooklyn train crash]]
**A commuter train from the [[Long Island Rail Road]] derails during the morning [[rush hour]] in [[Brooklyn]], [[New York (state)|New York]], injuring 103 people. [http://www.cbsnews.com/news/long-island-rail-road-train-derails-brooklyn/ (CBS)]

;Politics and elections
*[[First presidential transition of Donald Trump|Presidential transition of Donald Trump]]
**President-elect [[Donald Trump]] fills in more of his [[Executive Office of the President|White House staff]]. [http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/312681-trump-taps-top-aides-to-rnc-sessions-for-key-white-house-roles (''The Hill'')]:
***Trump nominates Katie Walsh, former [[Republican National Committee]] (RNC) chief of staff, as [[Deputy White House Chief of Staff]].
***Trump nominates [[Joe Hagin]], former Deputy Chief of Staff for President [[George W. Bush]], as Deputy White House chief of staff for operations. 
***Trump nominates Rajiv Shah, former RNC Deputy Research Director, as White House research director.
***Trump nominates Rick Dearborn, [[United States Attorney General]] designee and Senator [[Jeff Sessions]]' former chief of staff, as head of the White House legislative affairs office.
***Trump nominates [[Omarosa Manigault Newman|Omarosa Manigault]], former contestant on ''[[The Apprentice (American TV series)|The Apprentice]]'', as an assistant to the president and director of communications for the [[Office of Public Liaison]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/people/2017/01/04/omarosa-gets-job-trump-white-house-public-liaison-leader/96167028/ (''USA Today'')]
***Trump nominates [[Financial District, Manhattan|Wall Street]] lawyer [[Jay Clayton (attorney)|Jay Clayton]] to head the [[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission|Securities and Exchange Commission]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/wonk/wp/2017/01/04/trump-to-tap-wall-street-lawyer-jay-clayton-to-head-sec/ (''The Washington Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2017 Chicago torture incident]]
**[[Chicago]] Police arrest four [[African-American]] suspects after they stream a video on [[Facebook]] showing themselves torturing and [[scalping]] a bound and gagged, kidnapped, white man with a [[mental disorder]]. The four suspects will face elevated [[Hate crime laws in the United States|hate crime]] charges. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/jan/04/facebook-live-stream-video-man-attacked-chicago-trump (''The Guardian'')] [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/c0d964ae40f64e57a52cc3be213aa830 (AP)]

;Science and technology
*The [[National Aeronautics and Space Administration]] (NASA) announces the selection of two new [[Discovery Program]] space exploration missions: [[Lucy (spacecraft)|Lucy]], a mission to several [[Jupiter trojan]] asteroids, and [[Psyche (spacecraft)|Psyche]], a mission to the asteroid [[16 Psyche]], which is believed to be the exposed core of an early [[protoplanet]]. Both missions are scheduled for launch in the early 2020s. [https://www.nasa.gov/press-release/nasa-selects-two-missions-to-explore-the-early-solar-system (NASA)] [http://spaceflight101.com/lucy-and-psyche-discovery-mission-selection (Spaceflight101)]
